label: For "KYC Periodic Review Automation & Risk Re-rating": Automate periodic KYC refreshes by checking customer files against fresh data and re-rating risk, escalating changes to analysts. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels come from past analyst decisions, so the model repeats earlier habits.
